objects.name: Analytic 2154
objects.description: Real-time monitoring identifies ptrace syscalls or /proc/pid/mem write operations targeting Industrial Control System (ICS) service processes from a process that is not a debugger or vendor diagnostic tool. OT operational-fidelity gate: Alert only when execution violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/process or tool allowlist, or originates from an unauthorized user/tool, and is tied to an OT asset or follow-on OT-relevant action. Suppress vendor-signed software, approved engineering utilities, diagnostics, patching, backup, and documented maintenance.

x_mitre_log_source_references.name: auditd:SYSCALL
x_mitre_log_source_references.channel: Linux Audit SYSCALL/EXECVE/SOCKADDR records (configured audit rule): syscall=ptrace/process_vm_readv; process accesses an ICS service process PID from an image or UID not in the debugger/diagnostic allowlist

x_mitre_mutable_elements.description: Time window correlating a memory access event with a subsequent crash.
Allowlist of legitimate security/diagnostic tools authorized to perform cross-process memory access.
